officialSources.observation: Official District Burhanpur page says Burhanpur GIS is a Government of India/Madhya Pradesh district spatial-information system and links the public GIS host https://burhanpurgis.mp.gov.in/. Its described layers include land use and infrastructure, not a confirmed cadastral parcel layer.

Official Madhya Pradesh WebGIS 2.0 land-record map viewer. The current public HTML requires JavaScript and displays a Hindi/English security notice; no service configuration or feature schema was exposed by the bounded request.

Government service description says Madhya Pradesh parcel maps are accessed by selecting district, subdivision, tehsil and village, with maps and related forms available. It establishes the state service route, not a city-bounded API.

Government of India DILRMP page reports Burhanpur district statistics for digitized/georeferenced cadastral maps and parcels, including a BURHANPUR NAGAR tehsil row. These statistics are coverage evidence, not a parcel geometry endpoint or proof of exact WUP-point coverage.
